Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a custom antibody (1C6) to enrich for diethoxyphosphotyrosine (depY) adducts caused by chlorpyrifos oxon. While not a standard biological phosphorylation, it is a phosphate-based modification on tyrosine, mapping most closely to the mod_phospho modifier for routing purposes. The search specifically targeted a mass shift of ~136 Da on Tyrosine.

scope: depY-labeled peptides from tryptic digests of cell lysates were immunopurified by binding to immobilized 1C6

Tryptic peptides (194 μg in 0.29 mL of 20 mM NH4HCO3, 3% NP-40) were incubated with immobilized antibody 1C6 (105 μg monoclonal 1C6 on 50 μL Sepharose beads in 0.5 mL PBS, plus 0.01% azide) overnight at room temperature on a rotating mixer.
The 300 μL tryptic peptide samples were incubated with a 0.5 mL suspension containing 105 μg of immobilized 1C6 monoclonal conjugated to 50 μL of Sepharose beads.
Bound peptides were released by incubating the washed beads with 0.2 mL of 50% acetonitrile, plus 1% formic acid for 1.5 h.
